move.detail: +53 pts. Bigger in magnitude than 80% of the 2215 moves since 2018-01-03. The typical move is 33.2 pts; this is 1.1 sigma.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the top of its 1-year range, at the 85th percentile.

impact.meaning: This series cuts BOTH WAYS. A rise pushes mortgage rates UP through 10y treasury (path strength 34%) and DOWN through high yield spreads (path strength 32%). On current weights the inflation channel dominates, so the net effect of a rise is UP. The two can trade places depending on how far and how fast it moves: a modest rise is an inflation story, a violent one becomes a demand story.

chains.chain: Risk appetite → ↑ 10Y Treasury → ↑ MBS yield → ↑ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: Risk-on rotates out of Treasuries. Risk-off rotates in.
MBS are priced off the Treasury curve. This is the main channel.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.

chains.chain: Risk appetite → ↓ High yield spreads → ↓ MBS spread → ↓ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: General credit stress widens all spreads.
A wider spread raises the borrower rate even when Treasuries are unchanged.
